featured_reviews.name: Anjaneya Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text:
I added two stars for the good owners. The guy present in the store is an extremely cranky and irritable person. Last year, I purchased a large beautiful seated Ganesha with led lighting and 5 brass Hindu idols. Gave them Rs.25k worth of business in one order. At the time of selling, the cranky man had said the metallic gold paint on the Ganesha's garments will not get tarnished. But it started turning black in just 6 months. When I visited him today, I showed him pictures of the blackened paint and asked him the remedy. I had not uttered the word guarantee or warranty, I simply and calmly asked him what's the solution. And he started rudely telling me in a loud voice that there is no warranty or guarantee for any items in the store. I again asked him what's the solution and I understand there's nothing like a warranty for the art items. But he should offer a solution since he had claimed the paint will not fade or get tarnished. He again started almost shouting that I will never give warranty or guarantee. If you want to get it repainted, you have to pay the artists fees. I said ok what would be the approximate fees. Again screamed, How will I know? Artist is not available now. When he will be back, you have to pay whatever he asks for. And he did this ruckus in front of other customers in the shop potentially jeopardizing future sales.

I told him I will not shop there again left the store as I didn't want to traumatize my daughter who was with me. Even as we were leaving, the guy said, your choice don't come here again.

Apart from this negative experience with the cranky man, the store has beautiful artworks and the owners are decent people. Last year, they delivered the Ganesha to our home carefully so that we don't need to worry about damaging it while taking it home. So two stars to the owners. But zero for the cranky store guy.

featured_reviews.name: Shripad Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
🚫 Bad shop, bad attitude, bad experience.

I wouldn’t even give one star to this shop. The man at the counter (probably the owner) doesn’t care about customers—only money matters to him. You could be unhappy, frustrated, or even cheated… he won’t blink.

I bought a Sequence game thinking I’d get something good. But when I opened the box at home, the board was cheap and the colors were dull—felt like it came from the discount bin. So I went back to return it. And guess what? No return, no exchange, no respect. I wasn’t shocked, but the way he behaved was even worse. Cold, rude, and zero care.

And the best part? He kept the game AND charged me ₹680 for simply opening the box and bringing it back the next day. I left the game there, walked out frustrated, and basically paid him to cheat me.

💡 Tips to avoid getting tricked like I was:

Don’t trust the packaging—open and check before you buy.

Take a friend with you if possible. Some shopkeepers behave differently when not dealing with just one person.

Try buying from places that have good reviews, clear return policies, and basic respect for customers.

Ask questions before buying: What happens if the product is damaged? Can I return or exchange?

⚠️ If you love your hard-earned money, stay far away from shops like this. No one deserves to be treated like this.

featured_reviews.name: Sudip Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited Anupam Stationery and had an excellent experience. The store is very well-organized and offers an extensive range of products. It is one of the best places for students, as you can find A-to-Z stationery items under one roof. In addition to student essentials, the shop also has a good collection of toys, gifting items, and other useful products. The staff is supportive, and the overall service is impressive.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Nirvan Anand
featured_reviews.review_text:
On 21st September 2024 we had purchased this 6x6 Rubik's Cube from this damn Anupam stationery. They sweetly did not issue the bill and on trust we took the product. Next day some pieces poped out and when we had gone for replacement they refused to accept as we had no bill. What a scam ? Guys better buy online they never do this. Also offline stores pls don't cry "you don't get business nowadays".  This is what you do to your customers when they trust you Huh.
-–------------------------
The story continues and this time it's positive. Guys got a call from Mr.Sachin Shah floor manager on 25/02/25 (6months later is better late than never :)} Anupam Stationery and he took cognizance of the issue and has give a replacement product. All is well that ends well. I am upgrading the ratings from 1 to 3.5. I am always for offline buying it gives product with a buying experience which online can never give. Once again kudos to Sachin Shah from Anupam Stationery for not ignoring even small issues. Well Done Dear Sachin💐

featured_reviews.name: Sudarshan
featured_reviews.review_text: Anupam Stationery with its multiple outlets along the western line was the go to place for a lot of things. The store is still one of the few suppliers of quality stationery and allied products. They have a range of art and craft as well as digital products. Customer service is effective.

featured_reviews.name: Rishith Rambhia
featured_reviews.review_text: Anupam Stationery is a two-storied, mammoth-sized space filled with a plethora of options for all kinds of stationery and art needs. The variety here is unmatched — from school essentials to premium art supplies, everything is neatly organized and easy to find. The staff is friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable, making the shopping experience smooth and enjoyable. Great service, great products, and an overall must-visit for stationery lovers!

featured_reviews.name: Gazal Nakra
featured_reviews.review_text: One stop shop for all the stationary items. Located in Borivali West just opposite station. Parking could be done in the nearby mall area otherwise parking is a challenge. They sell mostly the products from China. People who have idea will understand that prices of all the items are on a higher side. We bought many gift items in bulk still no discount was given, moreover they did not even provide bags for it. We had to purchase the bags from them which were of very low quality and highly priced. I would never go there for the second time. Better to visit some small shops where you will get good quality and good price. There are many shops nearby which can be explored.

featured_reviews.name: M m
featured_reviews.review_text: If you are looking for quirky stationeries in borivali then this is the best place to visit. It's very spacious. The staff is courteous. For the artist in you..this is the best place for your quality art supplies.i have purchased a lot of gifting articles such as keychains post cards quilling flowers stickers, bubble wraps, packing papers as well as general stationeries such as pens sticky notes, mini envelopes etc.  Never been disappointed.
